title: Fix a Service targetPort
prompt:
Service `web-svc` in namespace `cka-sn-port` fails to forward HTTP traffic on port `80` to the Pods of Deployment `web`.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Fix Service `web-svc` so HTTP on port `80` reaches container port `80` on the `web` Pods.
2. Keep the Service type `ClusterIP`.

manifests:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: cka-sn-port
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: nginx:1.27-alpine
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: web-svc
  namespace: cka-sn-port
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: web
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 8080

checks.failure_hint: Patch the Service port targetPort to 80.
The Service forwards to the wrong container port.
Do not change the Service type.

reference_solution:
Fix the targetPort.
```bash
kubectl -n cka-sn-port patch service web-svc --type=merge -p='{"spec":{"ports":[{"port":80,"targetPort":80,"protocol":"TCP"}]}}'
```
hints: Inspect `k -n cka-sn-port describe svc web-svc` and check what port the container actually listens on in the Pod spec.
Update `spec.ports[0].targetPort` on `web-svc` to match the container listening port.
